welcome.title: [Welcome to AIS Alumni]
welcome.about: This account is run by the AIS Alumni Committee, a volunteer group of AIS graduates. It is not an official account of Aichi International School.
welcome.receiveItems:
・The result of your membership application
・Event invitations, with reminders one week and one day before
・News from the committee
・Follow and family-link requests
・Results of AIS record corrections
welcome.linked: ✅ Linked to your AIS Alumni account. Notifications will arrive here on LINE.
welcome.notLinkedTitle: ■ Not linked to the app yet
welcome.notLinked:
To get notifications here, link LINE in the app:
1. Tap “Open app” below and sign in (new here? you can sign up right away)
2. Go to Settings → LINE → “Link LINE”
3. Sign in with LINE and allow access — that's it
welcome.settings: Switch between LINE and email in the app under Settings → Notifications. If you block this account, we'll email you instead.
welcome.privacy:
We only store your LINE user ID and display name, and never read your chats. See the privacy policy for details:
{url}
welcome.buttonsText: See the directory, events and news in the app.
